R0_answer.what: item 11's answer: which share of this session's gap G = S(int8.zeros) - S(fp32.zeros) carries at least half of it

shares.per_op: G_op = e_op(int8) x O(int8) - e_op(fp32) x O(fp32), O = each format's op rate on zeros, e_op from rule R1
shares.lanes: G_lane = U(int8) - U(fp32), U = S(zeros) - S(m0.zeros): what issuing the micro-ops costs on zeros

R0_answer.line: a share carries the gap if its 95% lower bound >= G/2 (G = this session's mean gap); if none does, MIXED; if two do (impossible unless one is negative), both are named

R1_ops.what: Q132(b)'s second reading, S = c + e x ops: per-op work makes the gap

R1_ops.line: PASS if G_op's 95% lower bound >= G/2; FAIL if its upper bound < G/2; else INCONCLUSIVE

R2_lanes.line: LANES-CARRY if G_lane's 95% lower bound >= G/2; LANES-OPPOSE if its upper bound < 0 (the RTL count's direction: fp32's lanes clock more); else LANES-NEITHER

R3_per_time.line: PASS if G_rest's 95% lower bound >= G/2; FAIL if its upper bound < G/2; else INCONCLUSIVE

R4_b_reads.what: B-line reuse: r8 against k8 in fp32, the same op rate within 3% and twice B's half-line reads per op

R4_b_reads.line: PRICED if the 95% interval of r_B excludes 0 from above; NOT-RESOLVED if it includes 0; H_reads' value of this same statistic (its 5.93 pJ a read less the 3% of A reads a second r8 loses against k8, predicted_quantities.H_reads.fp32.r_B_pj) is named CONSISTENT if inside the interval, else INCONSISTENT
